'''Tulak Hord's lightsaber''' was the [[Melee weapon/Legends|weapon]] of [[Tulak Hord]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the original [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Along with many of Hord's artifacts, the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was lost in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], but the Sith Lord [[Darth Marr]] discovered the weapon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Fels]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="Bote" /> shortly before his ascension to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tulak Hord's lightsaber was first mentioned in the "Legacy of Tulak Hord" Codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. Darth Marr appears with a lightsaber in the game itself, though it is not known whether Marr kept Hord's lightsaber for his own personal use.

The lightsaber is available for purchase in the game's "[[Cartel Market]]." As such, it can be assumed that Marr did not carry Hord's lightsaber, as Marr's saber model differs greatly to that of Tulak Hord's.<ref name="Market" />
